content.title: Did You Know? You Beat the Odds
content.body: You need 18mg of iron daily—nearly double what men need—to prevent anemia and fatigue. Yet 1 in 5 young Singaporean women are iron-deficient. Add iron-rich foods like spinach, lentils, or lean meat to your meals, and pair them with vitamin C for better absorption. You were part of that 20%—and now you're not.

content.title: Your Heart Just Entered Athlete Territory
content.body: While your labs were transforming, something else quietly changed—your cardiovascular fitness. Your resting heart rate dropped from 64 to 55 bpm. That's a 9-beat improvement that puts you in athlete-level territory. Your HRV climbed 23.8% to 52ms, signaling strong recovery and reduced stress. This didn't happen overnight. This is 85 days of morning walks, consistent sleep, and your body optimizing itself cell by cell.
